component.name: riddim
component.summary: A minimal Spotify player for Linux

description.p: riddim is a minimal Spotify player for Linux: search tracks and playlists, play with queue, history, and radio, browse artist and album pages, and pin playlists to the sidebar. Native, responsive, and typically around 120 MB of RAM.

Playback runs on Soloist, Spotify's official headless player, which riddim downloads and keeps updated; Now Playing and media keys go through MPRIS. Requires Spotify Premium and a one-time setup: your own Spotify developer app for the library connection, then pairing the riddim playback device from any Spotify app. The full walkthrough ships in the app's first-run screens.
riddim is a Linux port of Cadence by Miho, a Spotify player for macOS; same engine, same design, with riddim's own mark and interface icons.
First release: search and library, playback with queue, history, and radio, artist and album pages, pinned playlists, MPRIS media keys, and light, dark, and system appearances.
